newsitem.title: MEXICO: Mexico Cetes rate jumps as investors go for equity.
newsitem.headline: Mexico Cetes rate jumps as investors go for equity.

text.p: Mexican overnight Cetes rates jumped 210 basis points to 19.60 percent in money market trade on Thursday as investors bailed out of fixed income to cash in on a surging stock market.
"The Bolsa is racing ahead and money is going from here to there," one market analyst told Reuters.
Mexican stocks passed the 5,000 point mark for the first time on Thursday and were up more than two percent in midday trade.
End of month pressure on banks to square their positions also added to the rise in rates, dealers said.
Overnight rates on bank paper were up 85 basis points to 20.85 percent.
Liquidity of 1.872 billion pesos was scheduled to return to the system from prior central bank participation.
